title: Techwear Hoodie — Module 12 Duct Blueprint
blurb: A full-back blueprint of a fictional underground duct junction, gauges and voltage icons included, paired with a small chest patch labeled MODULE 12. For techwear, darkwear and techno people who want a piece that feels like a uniform.

title: Ethical Hacker Long Sleeve — CTF Server Maze
blurb: An amber monoline maze of server racks and firewall gates on the back, with a tiny hooded silhouette slipping through. For pentesters, SOC analysts and CTF players who live in terminals and threat models.

title: Modular Synth Cap — Patch Me
blurb: Bold arched "PATCH ME" text over a hand-drawn oscilloscope sine wave, in a retro technical-manual style. Built for the hobbyist and semi-pro synth builder who lives for cables and the perfect patch.

title: First Draft Society Tee
blurb: "First Draft Society" in engraved serif, a single crossed-out line beneath it and a faint ink bleed — printed front and back. For anyone who calls themselves a writer before publishing a word.

title: Margins Are Where I Live Tee
blurb: A page crowded with handwritten marginalia, scattered asterisks and a coffee ring, front and back. For the ones who fill notebook margins with second thoughts and half-finished lines.

title: Still Revising Tee — Quill & Wax Seal
blurb: A circular engraved badge with crossed quill pens set in a wax-seal ring, "Still Revising" curving along the bottom. For poets, journal keepers and anyone permanently in the middle of another draft.

title: First Draft Society Tee — Dark Academia
blurb: "First Draft Society" in engraved serif with a crossed-out line and faint ink bleed, front placement. For anyone who has stared down a blank page and kept going anyway.
